card.name: Chinese history dates and names
card.fires_on: Digits inside years (19x, 18x) and name parts in text about Chinese or East Asian history, politics and film, such as Mao, Deng, May Fourth, Beijing Bicycle.

modes.label: Year digits
modes.description: A digit partway through a year in Chinese history passages, often in a date range.

modes.label: Name or title parts
modes.description: A piece of a personal name or work title in East Asian history or film context.
